title: Settings of the consent check (RB-094-05): Settings > Checks > Consent check

allowHosts.description: Hosts counted as the page's own, such as your CDN: no finding. A host such as cdn.example.com, or *.example.com for a domain and its subdomains.

rejectStep.description: After the first capture, click the banner's "Reject all" in the check's own session and capture again.

essentialCookies.description: Cookies of your own that are strictly necessary: no finding. A name such as cart_id, or a prefix such as pref_*.
